reuse.why: Changes only the existing getRangedAmountWorstCase and getApproxAmountWorstCase helpers and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; each rule is a one-line change in its single definition.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the worst-case helpers already live.

scope.why: Two helper bodies, their tests and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount minus threshold state 'lowest value allowed' directly and every consumer picks it up via getScheduledAmount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All scheduled-amount consumers already go through getScheduledAmount and the two worst-case helpers.
